story.0.0: What a great day to jump together!
story.0.1: Help! The eagle is taking me away!
story.0.2: Hang on, Bulpa! I'll climb all the way to the eagle's nest!
story.1.0: An eagle feather… I'm on the right track!
story.2.0: Bulpa's hat! The nest isn't far now.
story.3.0: You came to get me! Thank you, thank you!
story.3.1: I've never seen anyone jump that well… Can I come with you?

tuto.s1.text: Keep your finger on the screen, then let go to jump. The longer you hold, the farther you jump! The green part of the gauge shows the right power.
tuto.s1.hint: Let go when the gauge is in the green
tuto.s2.title: Aim for the circle
tuto.s2.text: Land right on the circle in the middle of the block: that's a PERFECT, and you get more points!
tuto.s2.hint: Land right on the circle in the middle
tuto.s3.title: Grab the coins
tuto.s3.text: Jump onto the block with a coin to grab it. With your coins, you can buy characters and hats!
tuto.end.title: You're ready!
tuto.end.text: Here, you couldn't fall. In the real game, if you fall, it's over… but you can always play again!
tuto.almost: Not quite… aim for the circle! 🎯
guide.title: How to play?
guide.blocks_sub: Every block and how to jump on it
guide.perfect_sub: How to get lots of points
guide.b.normal_text: The everyday block. Jump on it to get 1 point.
guide.b.normal_tip: Aim for the little circle in the middle!
guide.b.mini_text: It's smaller, so it's harder to reach… but it gives you 2 extra points!
guide.b.mini_tip: Look carefully at the distance before you jump.
guide.b.trampoline_text: When you land on it, it bounces you to the next block all by itself. You don't have to do anything!
guide.b.trampoline_tip: Your perfect streak is not lost.
guide.b.moving_text: It slides from side to side without stopping. You have to jump at the right moment.
guide.b.moving_tip: Wait until it comes back towards you, then jump.
guide.b.crumbly_text: It has cracks. When you stand on it, it shakes, then falls after a few seconds.
guide.b.crumbly_tip: Don't wait around: jump to the next block quickly!
guide.b.golden_text: A fragile block made of gold. The longer you stay on it, the more coins you get… but it falls in the end!
guide.b.golden_tip: Jump before it falls, or you lose the coins.
guide.b.ice_text: It's slippery! When you land on it, you slide a little in the direction of your jump.
guide.b.ice_tip: Land in the middle or a little before it, never after.
guide.b.blink_text: It keeps appearing and disappearing (crystal, or a cloud in Adventure). If it's gone when you land, you fall right through!
guide.b.blink_tip: Jump when it's fully visible. Once you're on it, it stays.
guide.b.coin_text: A coin floats above some blocks. Land on the block to pick it up.
guide.b.coin_tip: Use your coins to buy characters and hats in the shop.
guide.b.heart_text: A heart gives you an extra life. If you fall, you come back to your block instead of losing.
guide.b.heart_tip: You can keep up to 3 hearts.
guide.p.how: In the middle of every block there is a little circle. If you land right on it, it's a PERFECT!
guide.p.streak: Make several perfects in a row: each jump gives you more and more points.
guide.p.lose: If you miss the circle, the streak starts again from zero.
guide.p.tip: A trampoline bounce doesn't break the streak.

quest.s2.title: Inside Abyss
quest.s2.legend_go: The Mariana Trench: {j} jumps to the bottom of the trench!
quest.s2.legend_intro: All 45 Golden Pearls glow in the dark! The Mariana Trench reveals its secret.
quest.s2.legend_locked: The Mariana Trench: 3 pearls on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s2.story0: Gulp! Abyss the giant whale swallowed you and Bulpa whole! Hop from reef to jellyfish to swim back up.
quest.s2.story0a: What a lovely view of the ocean… Hey! What's that giant shadow under the water?!
quest.s2.story1: Bulpa tickles Abyss's throat… HIC! The hiccups make everything shake! Hold on, the way out is up there!
quest.s2.story3: Pshhh! Abyss blows you and Bulpa out through the blowhole: you're even! New character: the Whale!
quest.s2.story3a: Abyss takes a deep breath… and blows with all its might!
quest.s3.title: Close Encounters of the 3rd Cube
quest.s3.legend_go: The Black Hole Horizon: {j} jumps to the black hole!
quest.s3.legend_intro: 45 Cosmic Stars aligned! The portal to the Black Hole is open.
quest.s3.legend_locked: The Black Hole Horizon: 3 stars on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s3.story0: A green tractor beam sucks you up mid-flight! The mothership aliens want to test your reflexes in zero gravity.
quest.s3.story0a: I'm flying, I'm flyyying! … Uh, what's that green light above me?
quest.s3.story1: A little alien follows me everywhere with a clipboard. Is it counting my jumps?!
quest.s3.story3: Beep-Boop! The aliens are amazed by your bouncing skills and lend you their top pilot: Zorg!
quest.s3.story3a: The mothership sets you down gently. The aliens applaud with all six hands!
quest.s4.title: Operation Area 51
quest.s4.legend_go: The Armored Bunker: {j} jumps to the bunker roof!
quest.s4.legend_intro: All the Golden Dog Tags are yours! Access granted to the Armored Bunker.
quest.s4.legend_locked: The Armored Bunker: 3 tags on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s4.story0: Red alert! An army helicopter caught you and Zorg in a net! Free Zorg and escape from the secret base!
quest.s4.story0a: Phew, back on Earth! But what's that propeller noise getting closer?
quest.s4.story1: Shh! Zorg is hiding in a crate… but searchlights sweep the base and someone is watching you through binoculars!
quest.s4.story3: Mission accomplished, soldier! The helicopter pilot deserts the base to follow you: meet the Sergeant Major!
quest.s4.story3a: You and Zorg leap over the last fence! Sirens, searchlights… too late, you're free!
quest.s5.title: Meltdown Alert
quest.s5.legend_go: The Reactor Core: {j} jumps into the reactor core!
quest.s5.legend_intro: 45 Golden Uranium Flasks gathered! The Reactor Core is ready to be crossed.
quest.s5.legend_locked: The Reactor Core: 3 flasks on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s5.story0: BOOM! The reactor exploded and the base is flooded with glowing green acid. Jump on the floating barrels before they sink!
quest.s5.story0a: An alarm is wailing across the base and the reactor is flashing red. This doesn't look good…
quest.s5.story1: Bubbles rise from the acid… and two big eyes stare at you before diving back down!
quest.s5.story3: You survived the radiation… and made a slightly slimy new friend: Toxik!
quest.s5.story3a: The acid finally drains away and the sun breaks through the green cloud. Something slimy hops toward you…
quest.s6.title: Sweet Insomnia
quest.s6.legend_go: The Lucid Dream: {j} jumps to the cloud castle!
quest.s6.legend_intro: 45 Golden Moons light up the night! Dare you face the Lucid Dream?
quest.s6.legend_locked: The Lucid Dream: 3 moons on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s6.story0: Bulpa is having a nightmare! Bounce on the clouds of Dreamland to reach Bulpa, but watch out for the ones that fade!
quest.s6.story0a: So many adventures… Your eyelids are getting heavy… Zzz… But Bulpa is tossing and turning!
quest.s6.story1: One sheep, two sheep… A figure in pajamas sprinkles golden sand and chases away Bulpa's bad dreams.
quest.s6.story3: Ring! You and Bulpa wake up full of energy, and your dream guardian followed you: Morpheus!
quest.s6.story3a: The sun rises over Dreamland: Bulpa wakes up all smiles!
quest.s6.ch_coins: Count the {n} sheep along the way
quest.s7.title: Absolute Zero
quest.s7.legend_go: The Crystal Peak: {j} jumps to the ice throne!
quest.s7.legend_intro: 45 Golden Snowflakes! The storm parts to reveal the Crystal Peak.
quest.s7.legend_locked: The Crystal Peak: 3 snowflakes on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s7.story0: Brrr! A polar blizzard swept you onto the ice floe! The wind is strong and the ice is slippery: measure your jumps.
quest.s7.story0a: RIIING! The alarm clock goes off… but why is it suddenly so cold?!
quest.s7.story1: These footprints in the snow are… huge. And they're brand new!
quest.s7.story3: You broke the ice! The king of the ice floe joins your team: Frosty the Yeti!
quest.s7.story3a: CRACK! The big block of ice splits in two… and something furry climbs out!
quest.s7.ch_coins: Collect the {n} ice cubes on the way
quest.s8.title: Krakatoa's Wrath
quest.s8.legend_go: The Magma Chamber: {j} jumps into the heart of the magma!
quest.s8.legend_intro: All 45 Magma Gems fuse together! Dive into the Magma Chamber for the ultimate trial.
quest.s8.legend_locked: The Magma Chamber: 3 gems on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s8.story0: The super-volcano is erupting! Leap from obsidian stone to scorching geyser, fast: the rocks are crumbling!
quest.s8.story0a: The ground shakes under the ice floe… In the distance, the mountain starts to smoke. Uh-oh.
quest.s8.story1: A little flame is dancing in the lava and waving at you. Could volcanoes have a spirit?
quest.s8.story3: You made it out of the crater unharmed! The volcano spirit bows to your nerves of steel: meet Pyro!
quest.s8.story3a: The volcano finally calms down. A bright flame rises from the lava and bows to you.
quest.s9.title: The Great Clock Tower
quest.s9.legend_go: The Infinite Pendulum: {j} jumps to the heart of the clockwork!
quest.s9.legend_intro: All 45 Golden Gears mesh perfectly! The Infinite Pendulum starts swinging.
quest.s9.legend_locked: The Infinite Pendulum: 3 gears on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s9.story0: The eruption hurled you into a huge mechanical tower! Leap from cog to piston before the machinery flattens you.
quest.s9.story0a: The volcano spits one last blast… and launches you straight toward a gigantic tower!
quest.s9.story1: CUCKOO! A little door opens in the clock… An automaton watches you, ticking away.
quest.s9.story3: Tick-tock! You reach the top of the chime right on time. Chronos, the head automaton, salutes you and joins your team!
quest.s9.story3a: DONG! DONG! You ring the great bell at the top of the tower, right on time!
quest.s10.title: Attack of the Giant Garden
quest.s10.legend_go: The Royal Hive: {j} jumps to the hive!
quest.s10.legend_intro: 45 Golden Amber Drops gathered! The Royal Hive opens its doors.
quest.s10.legend_locked: The Royal Hive: 3 drops on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s10.story0: A shrinking ray made you and Bulpa tiny! Bounce from mushroom to lily pad and avoid the carnivorous plants!
quest.s10.story0a: Sparks fly from a strange machine… The ray hits you and Bulpa, and you both shrink!
quest.s10.story1: Oh no, a carnivorous plant swallowed Bulpa! A huge beetle is rolling a dewdrop toward it… It looks friendly.
quest.s10.story3: Bulpa is safe and the garden is behind you! Atlas the rhinoceros beetle lends you a hand for what comes next.
quest.s10.story3a: With one push of its horn, the beetle frees Bulpa and lifts a giant leaf: the way out of the garden is right there!
quest.s10.ch_coins: Gather the {n} grains of golden pollen
quest.s10.ch_bounce: {n} perfect bounces in the middle of mushrooms
quest.s11.title: Short Circuit
quest.s11.legend_go: The Mother Processor: {j} jumps to the Mother Processor!
quest.s11.legend_intro: 45 Golden Bits compiled! You've unlocked access to the Mother Processor.
quest.s11.legend_locked: The Mother Processor: 3 bits on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s11.story0: ZZZT! A power socket sucked you into an 80s arcade cabinet! Dodge the bugs and leap from pixel to joystick.
quest.s11.story0a: To get back to your normal size, you touch a power socket… ZZZT! Everything turns into pixels!
quest.s11.story1: VIRUS ALERT! A scanning beam passes through you… and a little pixel antivirus waves at you.
quest.s11.story3: HIGH SCORE BEATEN! The firewall lets you out with Pixel, the system's antivirus, as your new ally.
quest.s11.story3a: NEW RECORD! The counter goes wild and the pixels burst into fireworks!
quest.s12.title: The Pharaoh's Curse
quest.s12.legend_go: The Chamber of Anubis: {j} jumps to the royal sarcophagus!
quest.s12.legend_intro: All 45 Golden Amulets are gathered! The Secret Chamber of Anubis opens with a deep rumble.
quest.s12.legend_locked: The Chamber of Anubis: 3 amulets on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s12.story0: A teleport glitch drops you into a pyramid! The sand is rising: leap from sarcophagus to pillar before the doors close!
quest.s12.story0a: The teleporter glitches… ERROR… ERROR… Where will you land this time?
quest.s12.story1: A sarcophagus lid is moving on its own… and a little bandaged hand waves at you!
quest.s12.story3: You find the pyramid's secret exit! Ramses, the little mummy woken up by your jumps, decides to see the world with you.
quest.s12.story3a: A wall slides open and daylight pours into the pyramid: the secret exit!
quest.s12.ch_coins: Loot the {n} ancient coins on the columns
quest.s13.title: The Manor of Shadows
quest.s13.legend_go: The Forbidden Attic: {j} jumps to the haunted bell tower!
quest.s13.legend_intro: All 45 Golden Pumpkins light up! The Forbidden Attic unlocks its padlock.
quest.s13.legend_locked: The Forbidden Attic: 3 pumpkins on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s13.story0: The curse plunges the world into Halloween night! Ramses is shaking with fear: leap with him from pumpkin to candelabra.
quest.s13.story0a: The sarcophagus opens in a purple cloud… The sky darkens and the full moon rises.
quest.s13.story1: The candles suddenly go out… A white sheet glides through the wall, giggling. Ramses's bandages are rattling!
quest.s13.story3: Boo! No harm done: Casperon, the manor's prankster ghost, opens the gate for you laughing and follows you.
quest.s13.story3a: The old gate creaks open. The bats fly off toward the moon!
quest.s14.title: Rock Symphony
quest.s14.legend_go: The VIP Encore: {j} jumps to the VIP stage!
quest.s14.legend_intro: 45 Gold Records on the wall! You're invited to the VIP Stage for the ultimate encore.
quest.s14.legend_locked: The VIP Encore: 3 records on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s14.story0: To chase the ghosts away, turn the volume up! Jump from speaker to drum on the festival stage, to the beat of the bass!
quest.s14.story0a: The ghosts surround you! Quick, an electric guitar… and one chord at full volume!
quest.s14.story1: The crowd raises its arms… and a rockstar mascot crowd-surfs over the audience!
quest.s14.story3: What a legendary solo! The crowd goes wild and Decibel, the festival's rockstar mascot, hops on your tour bus!
quest.s14.story3a: Final chord! Flames shoot up from the stage and the crowd screams your name!
quest.s14.ch_coins: Grab the {n} guitar picks on stage
quest.s15.title: The Cloud Dojo
quest.s15.legend_go: The Dragon Palace: {j} jumps to the dragon palace!
quest.s15.legend_intro: All 45 Golden Shurikens are lined up! The gates of the Celestial Dragon Palace open.
quest.s15.legend_locked: The Dragon Palace: 3 shurikens on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s15.story0: Welcome to the cloud temple! A ninja master greets you among the cherry trees. Careful: the bamboo pillars are narrow!
quest.s15.story0a: Your last chord is so powerful that the shockwave launches you above the clouds… all the way to a temple!
quest.s15.story1: On the bamboo pillars, a young ninja jumps without a sound. Focus…
quest.s15.story3: Discipline, precision, balance! The grand master hands you your black belt and Shinobi, his best disciple, comes along.
quest.s15.story3a: GONG! The grand master ties a black belt around your waist. You've earned it!
quest.s16.title: Candy Factory
quest.s16.legend_go: The Royal Fountain: {j} jumps to the chocolate fountain!
quest.s16.legend_intro: 45 Golden Sugar Crowns tasted! The Royal Chocolate Fountain awaits for the grand finale.
quest.s16.legend_locked: The Royal Fountain: 3 crowns on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s16.story0: To celebrate your black belt, the whole gang is waiting at the chocolate factory! Jump from wafer to marshmallow over the chocolate!
quest.s16.story0a: A golden invitation comes fluttering in: grand banquet at the chocolate factory!
quest.s16.story1: A cream puff hops from marshmallow to marshmallow… and sticks its tongue out at you!
quest.s16.story3: Yum! You crossed the whole candy shop without getting coated in caramel. The head pastry chef gives you his sweetest creation: Choco-Chou!
quest.s16.story3a: Bulpa, the Eagle, Zorg and the whole gang are here! The giant cake bursts into sugar confetti!
quest.s17.title: Boarding party!
quest.s17.story0a: After the feast, the whole gang naps on a boat… when suddenly, a cannonball whistles past!
quest.s17.story0: Pirates kidnapped Bulpa! Jump from barrel to sail before they weigh anchor, and watch out for crates that give way!
quest.s17.story1: Bulpa waves wildly from the captain's cage… and a hooded figure is watching you from the crow's nest.
quest.s17.story3a: With one leap, you cut the cage rope and free Bulpa as the crew cheers!
quest.s17.story3: Bulpa is free! Amazed by your rigging skills, the ship's cabin boy joins your gang: Cubebeard!
quest.s17.legend_go: Treasure Island: {j} jumps to the cursed chest!
quest.s17.legend_intro: The 45 Gold Doubloons shine on the map! Treasure Island reveals its secret passage.
quest.s17.legend_locked: Treasure Island: 3 doubloons on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s18.title: Jurassic Panic
quest.s18.story0a: Fleeing the pirates, the ship sails straight into a glowing vortex… ROAAAR! What was that?!
quest.s18.story0: Welcome to prehistoric times! Zorg lost his saucer and a T-Rex is chasing him. Bounce from geyser to egg to reach him!
quest.s18.story1: The ground shakes with every step… Zorg waves at you, hiding behind a giant egg!
quest.s18.story3a: A triple bounce, and the T-Rex chases you… while Zorg restarts his saucer. Saved!
quest.s18.story3: Zorg is safe and sound! And the baby dinosaur that hatched decides to follow you everywhere: meet Rexy!
quest.s18.legend_go: Crater of Giants: {j} jumps to the royal nest!
quest.s18.legend_intro: The 45 Gold Fossils come together! The Crater of Giants opens its passage.
quest.s18.legend_locked: Crater of Giants: 3 fossils on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s19.title: The Secrets of Atlantis
quest.s19.story0a: The vortex spits the ship out in the middle of the ocean… and you sink straight down to a sunken city!
quest.s19.story0: Welcome to the ruins of Atlantis! Abyss the whale gives you air bubbles. Jump from column to giant shell!
quest.s19.story1: A statue lights up as you pass… and a little guardian in a diving suit shows you the way to the temple.
quest.s19.story3a: You touch the central crystal: the whole sunken city lights up in brilliant blue!
quest.s19.story3: Atlantis lives again thanks to you! Nautilus, the young guardian of the deep, joins your gang.
quest.s19.legend_go: The Coral Throne: {j} jumps to the sunken throne!
quest.s19.legend_intro: The 45 Gold Tridents ring out under the sea! The gates of the Coral Throne open.
quest.s19.legend_locked: The Coral Throne: 3 tridents on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s20.title: Zero Gravity
quest.s20.story0a: The Atlantis crystal shoots a beam into the sky… and sends you straight into orbit!
quest.s20.story0: Alert! Astro, the station's little robot, is drifting toward the asteroids. Bounce in zero gravity to catch him!
quest.s20.story1: Pixel hacks the station's airlock to open the way. Astro is only a few jumps away!
quest.s20.story3a: You catch Astro mid-flight and you both land gently on the station!
quest.s20.story3: Orbital rescue complete! Astro, the little cosmonaut robot, joins your gang.
quest.s20.legend_go: Saturn's Ring: {j} jumps along the rings!
quest.s20.legend_intro: 45 Gold Meteorites caught! The way to Saturn's Ring is clear.
quest.s20.legend_locked: Saturn's Ring: 3 meteorites on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s21.title: Westward Rush
quest.s21.story0a: The return capsule whistles across the sky… and crashes in the middle of the Wild West desert!
quest.s21.story0: A runaway train is racing toward a ravine, and Astro is stuck on the roof! Jump from wagon to hay bale to save him!
quest.s21.story1: A cowboy throws you his lasso… and up on the cliff, a hooded figure on horseback is watching you.
quest.s21.story3a: You unhook the locomotive just before the ravine and get Astro back safe and sound!
quest.s21.story3: Yeehaw! Impressed by your nerve, Sheriff Billy pins on his star and joins your gang.
quest.s21.legend_go: The Golden Canyon: {j} jumps to the secret mine!
quest.s21.legend_intro: The 45 Sheriff Stars shine in the sun! The Golden Canyon opens its passage.
quest.s21.legend_locked: The Golden Canyon: 3 stars on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s22.title: The Crystal Mine
quest.s22.story0a: The train brakes so hard it smashes into an old mine… CRACK! A rockslide blocks the tunnel!
quest.s22.story0: The rockslide split you from the gang! Cross the crystal tunnels, but watch out for slippery crystals!
quest.s22.story1: A little light blinks in the dark… A mole in a helmet digs a shortcut ahead of you!
quest.s22.story3a: You break through the last crystal wall and find the whole gang on the other side!
quest.s22.story3: Everyone's back together! Nugget, the explorer mole with an unbeatable nose, joins the adventure.
quest.s22.legend_go: The Royal Geode: {j} jumps to the heart of the geode!
quest.s22.legend_intro: The 45 Golden Diamonds light up the cave! The Royal Geode reveals its heart.
quest.s22.legend_locked: The Royal Geode: 3 diamonds on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s23.title: The Sky Circus
quest.s23.story0a: Climbing out through an air shaft, you come out under a giant big top… sitting on the clouds!
quest.s23.story0: The ringmaster wants to make Rexy his star act! Bounce from trampoline to trapeze to get him back!
quest.s23.story1: Drumroll! An acrobat clown juggles glowing balls and launches you toward the top of the big top.
quest.s23.story3a: You take Rexy's place in the giant cannon… BOOM! What a flight through the confetti!
quest.s23.story3: The crowd is on its feet! Rexy is free, and Boom-Boom the acrobat clown leaves the circus to follow you.
quest.s23.legend_go: The Star Trapeze: {j} jumps without a net!
quest.s23.legend_intro: All 45 Gold Tickets are in! The Star Trapeze grand finale begins.
quest.s23.legend_reward: Win: King of the Big Top
quest.s23.legend_unlocked: 👑 King of the Big Top is yours!
quest.s23.legend_locked: The Star Trapeze: 3 tickets on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s24.title: Arena of Champions
quest.s24.story0a: The circus cannon sends you above the clouds, facing a floating fortress…
quest.s24.story0: It's the lair of the Shadow Master, the figure who's been following you since the pirate ship! Prove you jump better!
quest.s24.story1: The path is too high… But all your friends arrive and give you a giant boost!
quest.s24.story3a: You reach the top of the fortress! The Shadow Master pulls back his hood… and applauds!
quest.s24.story3: Victory! The Shadow Master just wanted to challenge the best jumper in the world. He joins your gang!
quest.s24.legend_go: The Cube Pantheon: {j} jumps to glory!
quest.s24.legend_intro: The 45 Gold Cups shine! The Cube Pantheon opens its doors.
quest.s24.legend_locked: The Cube Pantheon: 3 cups on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s25.title: The Riddle of the Sphinx
quest.s25.story0a: You turn over the old hourglass from the treasure… A golden whirlwind sucks you in!
quest.s25.story0: The Hourglass of Ages has shattered! Its 8 golden grains are lost in the past. The first one shines… between the Sphinx's paws, by the Nile!
quest.s25.story1: The Sphinx opens one eye: "What jumps by day, glides by night and never falls?" Uh…
quest.s25.story3a: You land right on the Sphinx's nose: it bursts out laughing and hands you the golden grain!
quest.s25.story3: First grain found! Meow-Ra, the temple's sacred cat, hops into your bag for the rest of the journey.
quest.s25.legend_go: The Barque of Ra: {j} jumps to the sun!
quest.s25.legend_intro: The 45 Eyes of Horus are shining! The Barque of Ra carries you toward the sun.
quest.s25.legend_locked: The Barque of Ra: 3 eyes on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s26.title: The Hanging Gardens
quest.s26.story0a: The golden whirlwind drops you… into a tree! All around, gardens are floating in the sky.
quest.s26.story0: The Hourglass's second grain fell to the very top of the Hanging Gardens of Babylon. Climb from terrace to terrace!
quest.s26.story1: A scribe carves your jumps into a clay tablet… You're going down in History!
quest.s26.story3a: At the top of the ziggurat, the golden grain shines among the stars.
quest.s26.story3: Second grain! Lamassou, the little winged lion of the Ishtar Gate, flies away with you.
quest.s26.legend_go: The Ishtar Gate: {j} jumps to the golden lions!
quest.s26.legend_intro: The 45 Stars of Ishtar are shining! The great blue gate opens before you.
quest.s26.legend_unlocked: 👑 The Golden Lion King is yours!
quest.s26.legend_locked: The Ishtar Gate: 3 stars on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s27.title: The Feast of Olympus
quest.s27.story0a: Lightning splits the sky… and you find yourself on a column, above the clouds!
quest.s27.story0: Zeus took the Hourglass's third grain to decorate his throne! Climb up to Olympus… and watch out for his lightning.
quest.s27.story1: Hermes zips by on his winged sandals: "Not bad, for a cube!"
quest.s27.story3a: The gods raise their cups: your last jump makes Olympus tremble!
quest.s27.story3: Zeus hands back the grain with a laugh. Pegasoo, the winged foal, won't leave your side.
quest.s27.legend_go: The Throne of Zeus: {j} jumps to the top of Olympus!
quest.s27.legend_intro: The 45 Owls of Athena are shining! Zeus invites you up to his throne.
quest.s27.legend_locked: The Throne of Zeus: 3 owls on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s28.title: Ave, Bulpa!
quest.s28.story0a: Trumpets! You land in the middle of a giant arena… 50,000 Romans are watching you.
quest.s28.story0: Julius Caesar has put the Hourglass's fourth grain up as a prize: it goes to the best jumper of the games!
quest.s28.story1: A chariot charges into the arena! The crowd holds its breath…
quest.s28.story3a: Caesar stands up… and gives a thumbs up! The arena erupts with joy.
quest.s28.story3: Fourth grain! Maximus, the little gladiator, puts away his shield and joins your gang.
quest.s28.legend_go: The Great Circus: {j} jumps to the cheers of Rome!
quest.s28.legend_intro: The 45 Golden Eagles are shining! Caesar opens the gates of the Great Circus.
quest.s28.legend_locked: The Great Circus: 3 eagles on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s29.title: The Great Wall
quest.s29.story0a: The whirlwind sets you down on an endless wall winding over the mountains…
quest.s29.story0: The fifth grain is hanging from the highest New Year lantern! Run along the wall.
quest.s29.story1: The terracotta warriors turn their heads toward you… Are they alive?!
quest.s29.story3a: Fireworks burst and the lantern floats down to you.
quest.s29.story3: Fifth grain! Long, the little festival dragon, slips into your gang.
quest.s29.legend_go: The Forbidden City: {j} jumps to the Dragon Throne!
quest.s29.legend_intro: The 45 Red Envelopes are shining! The gates of the Forbidden City open.
quest.s29.legend_unlocked: 👑 The Golden Imperial Dragon is yours!
quest.s29.legend_locked: The Forbidden City: 3 envelopes on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s30.title: The City of Gold
quest.s30.story0a: You fall into a lake… in the middle of a city that shines with gold!
quest.s30.story0: The sixth grain is at the top of the Temple of the Sun. Careful, gold is slippery!
quest.s30.story1: A giant feathered serpent flies over you… and gives you a wink.
quest.s30.story3a: At the top of the temple, the sun rises and the golden grain lights up.
quest.s30.story3: Sixth grain! Quetzi, the little feathered serpent, curls around your arm.
quest.s30.legend_go: The Temple of the Sun: {j} jumps to the golden dawn!
quest.s30.legend_intro: The 45 Golden Suns are shining! The Temple of the Sun opens its steps to you.
quest.s30.legend_locked: The Temple of the Sun: 3 suns on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s31.title: The Terraces of Machu Picchu
quest.s31.story0a: Brrr… you wake up in the clouds, at the top of a mountain covered in terraces.
quest.s31.story0: A condor carried the seventh grain off into the fog! Jump from stone to stone.
quest.s31.story1: A llama spits on you… then shows you the way. Thanks (I think)!
quest.s31.story3a: The fog lifts: Inti's sun makes the golden grain shine.
quest.s31.story3: Seventh grain! Lamita the llama insists on coming along (and keeps on spitting).
quest.s31.legend_go: The Gate of the Sun: {j} jumps to Inti's disk!
quest.s31.legend_intro: The 45 Golden Llamas are shining! The Gate of the Sun lights up before you.
quest.s31.legend_locked: The Gate of the Sun: 3 llamas on every level ({n}/{t})
quest.s32.title: The Rainbow Bridge
quest.s32.story0a: A horn echoes through the fjord… you land on the prow of a longship!
quest.s32.story0: The last grain is at the end of the Bifröst, the rainbow bridge between the worlds. Charge!
quest.s32.story1: The Vikings bang their shields in rhythm: they're cheering you on!
quest.s32.story3a: The eighth grain joins the others… The Hourglass of Ages is whole again!
quest.s32.story3: The Bifröst brings you back to the present with your whole gang. Sven, the little Viking, jumped into the whirlwind with you!
quest.s32.legend_go: Valhalla: {j} jumps to Odin's great hall!
quest.s32.legend_intro: The 45 Golden Horns ring out! The gates of Valhalla open for you.

weekly.offline: Connect to the internet to play the map of the week.
weekly.no_tries: No tries left today: come back tomorrow!
weekly.error: Oops, that didn't work. Try again.
weekly.intro: The same map for everyone, harder and harder, with no bonuses or surprises. Only your best try of the week counts.
weekly.intro_noel: A Christmas map made of gift boxes, the same for everyone, harder and harder. Only your best try of the week counts.
weekly.empty: Nobody has played this week yet: be the first!
weekly.coins_rule: 10 free tries a day. At the end of the week, every player earns coins: the higher you rank, the more you get.
weekly.noel_items: Podium of a Christmas week: the Gifts trail. Play 3 Christmas weeks: the Gift blocks.
